2608.27035.title: Representing and Parsing Korean Constituency Structure at Different Levels of Granularity
2608.27035.paper_summary: Korean constituency parsing raises a representational challenge because the terminal units of a phrase-structure tree do not straightforwardly correspond to simple surface words. Korean eojeols are morphologically complex spacing units, and existing constituency resources differ in how they represent eojeol-internal morphology and non-overt elements. This paper compares three constituency parsing representations derived from the Penn Korean Treebank: Morpheme+XPOS, Eojeol+XPOS, and Eojeol+UPOS. We construct these representations by removing null elements, aligning Penn Korean phrase structure with overt eojeol tokens, preserving Penn Korean phrase labels where possible, and varying the terminal and preterminal layers. We then evaluate canonical non-binary transition-based constituency parsers in top-down, in-order, and bottom-up orders under a shared modeling and evaluation setup. All experiments use gold terminal segmentation and gold preterminal labels and therefore evaluate constituency parsing conditioned on gold morphosyntactic annotation. Eojeol terminals yield shorter transition sequences, but Eojeol+UPOS parsing substantially underperforms the morphologically richer conditions. Eojeol+XPOS narrows this gap, while Morpheme+XPOS gives the strongest results even after its predictions are projected to the eojeol terminal domain. Under these gold-annotation conditions, the results show that fine-grained morphological and XPOS representations provide valuable evidence for the evaluated parsers. This empirical finding concerns the information available for parsing and does not by itself determine the linguistically preferable terminal domain. Independently, linguistic and resource-design considerations motivate eojeol as a stable and interpretable surface domain for phrase-structure annotation, with morpheme-level and XPOS information retained as aligned morphosyntactic evidence.
2608.27035.paper_summary_zh: 韓語的句法樹結構解析提出了表徵上的挑戰，因為短語結構樹的終端單元並不直接對應於簡單的表面詞。韓語的 eojeol 是形態學上複雜的空間單位，現有的句法資源在如何表示 eojeol 內部形態和非顯性元素方面存在差異。本文比較了來自 Penn Korean Treebank 的三種句法解析表徵：Morpheme+XPOS、Eojeol+XPOS 和 Eojeol+UPOS。我們通過去除空元素、將 Penn Korean 短語結構與顯性 eojeol 令牌對齊、在可能的情況下保留 Penn Korean 短語標籤，以及變化終端和前終端層來構建這些表徵。然後，我們在共享的建模和評估設置下，評估典型的非二元轉換基於的句法解析器，採用自上而下、按序和自下而上的順序。所有實驗均使用金標終端分段和金標前終端標籤，因此評估基於金標形態語法標註的句法解析。Eojeol 終端產生較短的轉換序列，但 Eojeol+UPOS 解析在形態學上較為豐富的條件下表現顯著不足。Eojeol+XPOS 縮小了這一差距，而 Morpheme+XPOS 即使在其預測被投影到 eojeol 終端領域後，仍然給出了最強的結果。在這些金標註條件下，結果顯示細粒度的形態學和 XPOS 表徵為評估的解析器提供了有價值的證據。這一實證發現涉及可用於解析的信息，並不單獨決定語言學上更可取的終端領域。獨立地，語言學和資源設計考量促使 eojeol 成為短語結構標註的一個穩定且可解釋的表面領域，保留形態素級別和 XPOS 信息作為對齊的形態語法證據。
